description: Grove, the AI gateway, and the control credential Press calls it with. A pool of trial keys per Product Trial is minted ahead under the trial team there, each capped at the trial key cap for its life and minted into the product's Model Group; a Product Trial site takes one of its product into its site config as ai_keys, and Press revokes it so many days after.

fields.description: The Grove site that serves AI, e.g. https://grove.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Grove URL

fields.description: Minted by Grove for Press on Enroll.
fields.label: Control Credentials

fields.description: The Grove Team trial keys are minted under. Create it at Grove first, on the Press Trial tier; a key keeps the team it was minted under.
fields.label: Trial Team

fields.description: The Grove geography the pools' keys are minted in, one of Grove's geography names; a key dials that geography's gateway. A key minted earlier keeps its own.
fields.label: Trial Key Geography

fields.description: Stops the 5-minute job from minting new keys. The pools keep their sizes and their ready keys; retries of revokes still run.
fields.label: Pause Pool Refill

fields.description: What one trial site may spend through its key in all, whole USD. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it.
fields.label: Trial Key Cap (USD)

fields.description: A trial site's key is revoked at Grove this many days after the site took it, whatever the site does. 0 keeps the key until the site is archived.
fields.label: Revokes Automatically After (Days)

fields.description: Stops a new trial site from taking a key from its pool. It runs without one, as with an empty pool; a site that already holds a key keeps it.
fields.label: Pause Key Assignment

fields.description: One row per Product Trial: how many trial keys Press keeps minted and ready for its sites, under the trial team, and the Grove Model Group those keys add to the team's catalog. A job every 5 minutes refills every pool. A product without a row gets no key.
fields.label: Trial Products

name: Grove Settings
